# SAYANJALI NEXUS PRIVATE LIMITED

SAYANJALI NEXUS PRIVATE LIMITED is a technology-driven enterprise building across Artificial Intelligence, Blockchain, Enterprise Software, and Developer Infrastructure — with agriculture, logistics, and community ventures on the long-term roadmap.

To become a globally respected innovation ecosystem that transforms industries through technology, sustainability, healthcare, agriculture, and public impact.

## Products
### NexusIntel AI
A multi-tenant SaaS foundation for CRM, organization management, subscriptions, role-based access control and executive intelligence.
Status: Beta. Repository: https://github.com/SHalimoosavi/SYJ-NexusIntel-AI

### SAYANJALI BLOCKCHAIN
An independent Layer-1 protocol engineering project with a Go production-track node and a Python reference implementation.
Status: Testnet-stage. Repository: https://github.com/SHalimoosavi/SAYANJALI-BLOCKCHAIN

### SYJ OpenTrade Logic
An explainable HTS classification engine using deterministic General Rules of Interpretation decision logic and a REST API.
Status: Beta. Repository: https://github.com/SHalimoosavi/SYJ-OpenTrade-Logic

### SYJ Aegis
A local static-analysis tool for reviewing AI-agent security and governance risks.
Status: Beta. Repository: https://github.com/SHalimoosavi/SYJ-Aegis

### SYJ EdgeMind
A private, offline AI runtime direction for low-memory devices using quantized GGUF models and CPU inference.
Status: Experimental. Repository: https://github.com/SHalimoosavi/SYJ-EdgeMind

### SYJ LLM
An offline-first C++ LLM runtime built around llama.cpp and GGUF, with a local model registry and memory-aware execution.
Status: Experimental. Repository: https://github.com/SHalimoosavi/SYJ-LLM

### SYJ Deploy
A self-hosted Git-based deployment dashboard for cloning, building, running and monitoring application projects.
Status: Beta. Repository: https://github.com/SHalimoosavi/SYJ-DEPLOY

### SYJ LaunchPad
An open-source self-hosted Web3 launchpad foundation for multi-chain sales, wallet authentication, vesting and claims.
Status: Prototype. Repository: https://github.com/SHalimoosavi/SYJ-LaunchPad

### SYJ HCM
A multi-tenant human capital management and applicant tracking platform for employee and recruitment workflows.
Status: Prototype. Repository: https://github.com/SHalimoosavi/SYJ-HCM

### DevXchange
A developer-focused marketplace project for software, SaaS, applications and AI projects with verification and licensing workflows.
Status: Prototype. Repository: https://github.com/SHalimoosavi/DevXchange

### SYJ Video Forge
An open-source text-to-video and image-to-video application with a static frontend, local backend and pluggable inference providers.
Status: Experimental. Repository: https://github.com/SHalimoosavi/SYJ-Video-Forge

### SYJ GridSync OS
Industrial edge middleware for telemetry ingestion, grid-constraint validation and distributed energy resource orchestration.
Status: Experimental. Repository: https://github.com/SHalimoosavi/SYJ-Gridsync-Os

### SYJ TalentFlow CLI
A recruitment automation CLI for resume parsing, candidate matching, interview preparation and recruiter communications.
Status: Beta. Repository: https://github.com/SHalimoosavi/SYJ-TalentFlow-Cli

### SYJ LeadForge
An open-source lead qualification and website-audit toolkit for freelancers, web developers and agencies.
Status: Beta. Repository: https://github.com/SHalimoosavi/SYJ-LeadForge

### SYJ QuickStock Sync
An offline inventory application for small vendors with local stock records, sales, dispatch, restocking and reports.
Status: Beta. Repository: https://github.com/SHalimoosavi/SYJ-QuickStock-Sync

### SYJ Mail Intelligence AI
A self-hostable email assistant for Gmail classification, importance scoring, summaries and reply drafting using local models.
Status: Beta. Repository: https://github.com/SHalimoosavi/syj-mail-intelligence-ai

### SYJ GST Reconciliation
A Python tool for reconciling supplier and purchase GST invoice workbooks and producing Excel reports.
Status: Beta. Repository: https://github.com/SHalimoosavi/SYJ-GST-Reconciliation

### SYJ RE-Workstation
A command-line toolkit for static APK inspection, metadata extraction, permissions review and report comparison.
Status: Prototype. Repository: https://github.com/SHalimoosavi/SYJ-RE-Workstation

### AI Zara Web Widget
An embeddable floating chat widget for adding an AI assistant interface to a website.
Status: Prototype. Repository: https://github.com/SHalimoosavi/AI-Zara-web-widget

### SYJ GitHub Optimiser
A command-line tool for automating GitHub profile README, repository topics and release workflows.
Status: Beta. Repository: https://github.com/SHalimoosavi/SYJ-Github-Optimiser

### SYJ Personality For GitHub
A GitHub profile analysis tool that scores public profile signals and produces archetypes, charts and shareable cards.
Status: Prototype. Repository: https://github.com/SHalimoosavi/SYJ-Personality-For-Github

### SYJ Calling CRM
A lightweight CRM for tracking leads and calls, built with a Node.js service and TypeScript application stack.
Status: Prototype. Repository: https://github.com/SHalimoosavi/SYJ-Calling-CRM

### SYJ OS
A browser-based virtual-device simulator prototype for exploring system interface and product concepts.
Status: Prototype. Repository: https://github.com/SHalimoosavi/SYJ-OS

### SYJ CanvasForge
A browser-based PDF, image and document editor that processes files on the client side.
Status: Beta. Repository: https://github.com/SHalimoosavi/SYJ-CanvasForge

### SYJ PropertySync
A property-listing synchronization proof of concept demonstrating validation, normalization and duplicate detection.
Status: Prototype. Repository: https://github.com/SHalimoosavi/SYJ-Property-Sync

### SYJ Logistics Fabric
A self-hostable reference node for sharing signed shipment events between independently operated logistics systems.
Status: Prototype. Repository: https://github.com/SHalimoosavi/SYJ-Logistics-Fabric
